name: Prof. Manish Kumar Goyal
title: Chair Professor – BIS Standardization
office: IIT Indore, Simrol, Indore – 453552, Madhya Pradesh, India
bio: Prof. Manish Kumar Goyal is a Chair Professor for BIS Standardization and Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering at IIT Indore, where he leads research at the intersection of water resources, climate change, and artificial intelligence. His work applies big data, remote sensing, and AI-driven modeling to problems in hydrology, air quality, and climate resilience, with the goal of informing more sustainable and climate-resilient infrastructure and policy.

highlight.title: Top 2% Scientists Worldwide
highlight.description: Ranked among the Top 2% of scientists globally in the environmental engineering subdiscipline by Stanford University, for six consecutive years (2020–2025).
